Mia (Marketing): Quick ask — before we lock the launch post, we need traceable provenance for the performance claims. specifically: p50/p95/p99 numbers for text-gen and embeddings, exact payloads, warmup profile, and any opt-in quantized variants used.
Sam R (eng-runtime): Ack. Which artifacts do you need? raw logs, aggregated CSVs, or the exact synthetic payload files?
Mia (Marketing): All of the above ideally. The blog will call out numbers and a small appendix will link to the raw samples. We also need the exact command/config so legal/press can sign off.
Oliver (runtime): We have the run manifest + per-request traces in s3. current location: s3://redwood-internal/perf/launch-2026/281224-sweep/ — contains raw-requests.jsonl, warmup.log, aggregated_percentiles.csv, and run-manifest.yml
Nina (data-ops): Heads up — some of those buckets are internal-only. We can prepare a sanitized zip (no IP, no customer payloads) and a checksummed bundle. Do you need timestamps preserved?
Mia (Marketing): Yes please keep timestamps. For auditability we'll surface start/end times. Also want the sample payloads as-is so our reproducibility doc can re-run.
Sam R (eng-runtime): Repro note: the original runs used the fastpath quantized kernels for A100 and a 4-step warmup (10 warmup requests at small size). If you want exact flags: 
```
--model gpt-open-13b-q4f14
--warmup 10
--batching profile=launch-2026
--seq_len 512
```
Oliver (runtime): We can re-run on Dedicated if you want non-quantized baselines. It will add ~6 hours to schedule if we queue capacity.
Mia (Marketing): Please do a non-quantized baseline too — legal asked for conservative numbers. If capacity is a blocker, a small synthetic rerun (1000 requests) that mirrors the original distribution is fine.
Nina (data-ops): For delivery we'll include: checksummed zip + README with run commands + aggregated_percentiles.csv (p50,p90,p95,p99) + sample_payloads.jsonl + warmup.log + env snapshot. We'll redact any internal-only metadata.
Sam R (eng-runtime): One more detail: our percentile calc uses a 99.9% trim to reject extreme infra noise. Want that called out in the methodology?
Mia (Marketing): Yes call it out. Add a short blurb describing trimming and the warmup exclusion window (first 60s excluded).
deploy-bot: scheduled-perf-sweep finished for 281224-sweep (artifacts uploaded) :white_check_mark:
Oliver (runtime): I'll kick a reproducibility rerun with non-quantized weights at low priority. ETA: artifacts in ~8hrs. Will post S3 path + SHA256.
Nina (data-ops): We'll also generate a minimal reproducibility notebook (Colab friendly) that consumes the sample_payloads.jsonl and posts to a public demo endpoint (sanitized).
Mia (Marketing): Awesome. Can we get the sanitized zip + README by EOD tomorrow? Need to wire into the launch repo and the press pack.
Sam R (eng-runtime): EOD tomorrow is tight but doable — Oliver and I will prioritize the baseline rerun. If capacity slips we'll hand off the synthetic 1k rerun instead.
Mia (Marketing): Thank you. Please @me when the artifact link is ready.
Oliver (runtime): Will do — assigning self as point person.
Nina (data-ops): I'll prep the bundle and post a permalink to the marketing channel when done.
Mia (Marketing): :raised_hands: thanks team — this helps the compliance folks sleep better.
